headline: Easy breeding chain: Kingpaca
title: Easy Kingpaca Breeding Chain in Palworld | 3 Steps From Easy Pals | Palworld Breeding Guide
video_script: Want a giant Kingpaca mount? Follow these three easy breeding steps. Step one: breed Vanwyrm with Woolipop to get Yakumo. Step two: breed that Yakumo with Lovander to get Sweepa. Step three: breed that Sweepa with Dumud, and the egg hatches into Kingpaca! Every step is checked against Palworld one point zero breeding data. Put each pair on the Breeding Farm with a cake. Which Pal should I chain next? Comment below!
description: Easy 3-step Palworld 1.0 breeding chain to Kingpaca: Vanwyrm + Woolipop = Yakumo, Yakumo + Lovander = Sweepa, Sweepa + Dumud = Kingpaca. Each step verified on PalBreedCalc and with the breeding formula from PinDrop's combi ranks.
